name: pg_stat_backtrace
abstract: Capture C-level stack backtraces of any PostgreSQL process from SQL.
description: pg_stat_backtrace exposes pg_get_backtrace(pid) and pg_log_backtrace(pid) functions that capture the C-level stack of any PostgreSQL backend or auxiliary process on the same host using ptrace(PTRACE_SEIZE) + libunwind. Unlike pg_log_backend_memory_contexts(), the target is not required to be cooperative or responsive to signals, which makes the module particularly useful for debugging hung or stuck processes.
